## 1 · Safe intake
Public portfolio webhook, schema normalization and rejection of secret-like fields. No company endpoint is called.

## 2 · Three original orchestration exercises
Each branch uses synthetic inputs and original deterministic logic to demonstrate mapping, policy decisions and system-integration thinking.

## 3 · Human control and observable result
The workflow records a simulated approval, returns a structured audit trail and performs zero external writes in dry-run mode.
